o1: Enables myosin II tail binding activity; protein serine/threonine kinase activity; and ubiquitin protein ligase binding activity. Involved in cell polarity; spindle orientation; anterior/posterior axis specification; asymmetric neuroblast division; asymmetric protein localization involved in cell fate determination; and vulval development. Located in P granule and cell cortex. Interacts with LET-99. Is part of the PAR polarity pathway. Is expressed in several structures, including P0; Psub1; Psub2; germ line; and nervous system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in visual impairment and progressive phthisis bulbi. Orthologous to several human genes including MARK1 (microtubule affinity regulating kinase 1).
